title: Git Slides
subtitle: Example code review: simplify the deck format

slides.title: Git Slides
slides.subtitle: From typed variants to one universal deck format.

slides.title: One slide shape, inferred from intent
slides.markdown:
- The deck no longer needs `type`, theme settings, or a full-width diff variant.
- A slide with `diffs` renders as a split review; everything else becomes a note.
- The title layout remains explicit because it has no diff and is only used to open the presentation.

slides.title: Theme and option complexity disappears
slides.markdown:
- Deck input is now just `title`, `subtitle`, and `slides`.
- Theme colors, numeric pagination bounds, strict unknown-property rejection, and four rigid slide variants were removed.
- The schema stays small enough to read without a reference guide.

slides.title: Default colors become part of the theme
slides.markdown:
- CSS variables are now static, so JSON no longer needs a `theme` object.
- Dead styles for removed slide types and alignment options were deleted with them.
- The default appearance remains unchanged.
